logp.method_description: The partition coefficient (logPo/w) of each compound was determined experimentally by the “shake flask” method at room temperature following reported methods. (55) A mixture of 1-octanol and PBS in equal amounts was shaken for 24 h, after which the phases were allowed to separate for 24 h. Then, a 1 × 10–5 M solution of each compound was prepared in 1-octanol/PBS (1:1), and the mixture was stirred for 24 h. After 24 h of stirring, the mixture was allowed to stand for 24 h to allow the two phases to separate. Finally, the concentration of each compound in the two phases was determined by UV–vis spectroscopy. The logP was determined by eq 2. (83) log P = log(Aap / (Abp - Aap)) where Aap is the absorbance after partition, and Abp is the absorbance before partition.
